how: B1952 (main's own recomputation of this note, verification/wa2_on_main.py), part A: below 2000 the act fixes exactly one line of F_p^2 at p = 5 only, two exactly when p = +-1 mod 5, none otherwise (0, 1, 0, 2, 0 at p = 3, 5, 7, 11, 13). It is the splitting of x^2 - 3x + 1 mod p, so 'where the act names a unique line' and 'the prime of the act's discriminant' are one condition
